What to know before visiting from Central Phoenix.

Appointments from Central Phoenix take place at 6022 N 16th St, Phoenix, AZ 85016. Call 602-607-5686 if you need help selecting a service or planning a group visit. The salon is open Monday–Saturday 9:30 AM–7 PM and Sunday 10 AM–5 PM; available booking times may end earlier. Free on-site parking is available. Check the current menu and booking flow for service choices and starting prices.

View current menu →

Plan your visit · Spa Pedicures

Select a pedicure by treatment sequence, time, and finish.

The current menu ranges from essential grooming to longer specialty rituals. Organic Spa is the featured everyday spa choice at 50 minutes, while Pearl, Jelly, CBD, and Gold extend products, skin-care steps, massage, or total time. Regular polish and gel are finish decisions layered onto the treatment tier. Reserving those details before arrival helps the booked time match the work.

Compare spa pedicures →

Another option · Aprés Gel-X

Extension bookings should name the old product and the new goal.

For Gel-X, state whether removal is required and choose a complete new set with the intended length, shape, finish, and repair needs. A soft-gel extension visit is not an acrylic fill.
